hero_subtitle: Ages 3–17 · Saturday mornings · All levels welcome
about_intro: We form teams and divisions based on age. We follow US Soccer principles to develop kids — physically, technically, strategically, and grow their Soccer IQ.
about_bullets: Fall: Teams begin practicing mid-August; games run September to early November.
Spring: Teams begin practicing end of March; games run April to mid-June.
volunteer_text: We have trainers who support coaches throughout the season. If you have energy and want to help, we want you.
divisions_note: All age groups play Saturday mornings between 8:30 AM and noon. Professional Tecnica trainers lead every training session and are present on game days to support coaches and players.
players_bring: Soccer ball (write child's name on it)
Reusable water bottle (write child's name on it)
team_placement_bullets: Teams are formed by an automated computer draft based on age, grade level, and gender.
There are no player, coach, or teammate requests in any division. The only exceptions are siblings and special circumstances.
If you are considering asking for an exception, please be prepared to volunteer as a coach.
We do our best to make teams as fair as possible.
Coaches will reach out to families 1-2 weeks before the season starts.
register_highlight: Please register early. Late registrations cannot be guaranteed team placement or uniforms. Full payment is required to be placed on a waitlist.
waitlist_text:
We run a waitlist when registration approaches our limit for any division. Registering for the waitlist holds your place in line. If you are on the waitlist and we don't assign you to a team by Week 3, you can receive a full refund.

If a division needs coaches, players whose parent volunteers to coach will be given priority on the waitlist.
cta_subtext: June 1 – August 20, 2026 - Season starts early September
how_to_register_bullets: Only create a new account if you are new to Jackson Soccer Club. If your child has played on a Jackson travel team or in our Intramural Program, you already have an account.
Use the Login button in the upper right to sign in to your existing account, then choose from the programs available for your children.
If you do not remember your login or password, use the "Forgot Login or Password" link on the login page.
Players registering after official registration closes will be placed on a waitlist.
Matching uniforms and team placement cannot be guaranteed for players who register after official registration ends.
Team assignments and schedules are released 1-2 weeks before the season begins. Once teams are formed, your coach becomes your point of contact.
